items.summary: Add a delivery script that gathers/copies the entire repository into a single local "project folder" so the user can place all program files into one directory on their computer in one command (excluding .git, node_modules, dist/build, .dfx, and existing exports).

Update the delivery documentation to clearly explain how to create the single project folder and (optionally) how to create the ZIP, including exact commands to run from the repository root and where the output will be located on disk.

Ensure the existing ZIP export continues to produce an archive that contains exactly one top-level folder with all program files, and that the console output is English-only (remove emoji-only cues if present).
